title: Diverse Angling Fishing Charters
specs: Fish species include steelhead, king and coho salmon, brown trout, smallmouth bass, pike, walleye, lake trout, cisco, perch
Fish in multiple rivers including Manistee, Grand, Muskegon, Pere Marquette, Betsie
Fish in lakes including Grand Traverse Bay, Betsie Lake, Lake Leelanau, Manistee Lake
Fishing methods include float fishing, fly fishing, bottom bouncing, plugging, vertical jigging, casting, live bait, trolling
All clients 17 & older must purchase a Michigan all species fishing license
River trip for 1-2 anglers, can add 3rd or 4th angler
Lake fishing for 1-4 anglers, can add 5th & 6th angler

blurb: Guests fish various rivers and lakes in Northern Michigan targeting species like steelhead, salmon, trout, bass, pike, and walleye using multiple fishing techniques. Charters include full and half day options for river and lake fishing, plus sunset cruises. The operator uses custom boats equipped for fishing and comfort.
extraNote: $100 non-refundable deposit required for all trips · Trips cancelled within 24 hours are responsible for half the trip cost unless cancelled by captain · If trip has left dock and client cancels, full payment is required
